map.先把 pre、textarea、script、style 这几类标签的整块内容抽: First extract the whole blocks of pre, textarea, script and style into placeholders (recording their order for restoration). When comment removal is enabled, delete HTML comments but keep those starting with conditional comments. When whitespace collapsing is enabled, process each node with a character state machine: tags and attribute values pass through untouched, while runs of whitespace inside text nodes collapse to a single space; in safe mode whitespace is removed only at block-level tag boundaries and a single space is kept at inline element boundaries (so span/strong and similar elements do not run together), while unsafe mode additionally removes whitespace-only text between tags. Finally trim leading/trailing whitespace and restore the placeholders to the original block content. Compression ratio = (1 − output length ÷ original length) × 100%, rounded to 1 decimal (0 when the original length is 0), and the original size, output size and compression ratio are shown
